caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a cast iron cooking vessel known as an aebleskiver pan or specialty skillet. It has a circular arrangement consisting of seven round, bowl-shaped cavities. These cavities are arranged in a hexagonal pattern: six around the edge and one in the center. The pan has short legs on the bottom for support, with three legs visible, and a straight handle with a rounded end and a hole for hanging. The handle extends to the right. The entire object is depicted in shades of gray and black, with subtle gradients creating the appearance of shadow and depth. The background is plain and light in color, contrasting with the darker, textured depiction of the pan. The composition positions the pan slightly above and to the left of the drawing center, with the handle extending towards the upper right.
title: Muffin Pan
